packet: 64 bytes:55,D0,operation,checksum,length,offsetLo,offsetHi,0,data[0..length-1],zero padding. Checksum=sum(bytes4..7+length)&255; length<=56. Responses AA,D0,status,checksum,length,offsetLo,offsetHi,0,data. Read replies echo requested length/offset. Controls return zero length/offset. No unsolicited status.

operations.2: write staged configuration, first block must start offset0
operations.3: apply staged configuration,4-byte LE CRC32 of all664 bytes; every byte must have been staged
operations.4: begin calibration:32 released frames then endpoint learning
operations.5: finish calibration:requires36 valid ranges and every key released
operations.6: enable typing:requires bank verification and full calibration; release interlock
operations.8: save current configuration/calibration to keyboard journal; calibration must be idle
operations.9: reset custom RAM settings, no flash erase
operations.12: load saved journal settings; release interlock

controls: Operations4..12 have length0/offset0. Operation3 length4/offset0. All writes must be explicit user actions. No stock settings codec compatibility.

statusLayout.16: calibrated mask low u32 (live learning mask while calibrating)
statusLayout.203: Uncalibrated startup baseline: 0 unused, 1 collecting, 2 active. Does not change real calibration flags.

configLayout.1: 3 group-to-output indices, permutation0,1,2. Output0 PC13,1 PC14,2 PB10. Default2,0,1.
configLayout.6: flags u16:bit0 bank wiring verified,bit1 enable typing at startup; other bits0
configLayout.12: calibrated mask high u32,only low4bits valid
configLayout.160: 36 key records of14bytes:actuation u16(10..990),hysteresis u16(1..500),RTpress u16(5..1000),RTrelease u16(5..1000),normalUsage u8,FnUsage u8,flags u8(bit0 RT,bit1 disabled),topDeadzonePercent u8(0..40),bottomDeadzonePercent u8(0..40),reserved0 u8

usages: 0 none;4..A4 ordinary keyboard codes;E0..E7 modifiers;FF internal momentary Fn;FE transparent only in Fn layer. UI should offer named common keys and raw hex fallback with validation.
hardwareStatus: Compiled-instruction and browser verification. Windows controller enumeration and physical input require a hardware test.

lighting.brightness: Header bytes 2 and 3 keep channel order and LED data rate in bit 0. Bits 1–7 store 100 minus the keyboard and strip brightness respectively. Old profiles use zero in these bits, yielding 100%.
operations: 2 set up to 14 palette entries of index+RGB
8 read last transmitted RGB bytes, 36 physical key colors then 5 lightbar colors
lighting.power: PA9 and PA10 high after latches are cleared and 2 MHz push-pull selected. 10 ms settling. Data PB15 SPI2 and PB5 remapped SPI1.

persistence: Two alternating 4 KiB CRC records. The inactive sector is replaced as sixteen 256-byte pages, with the commit marker in the final page. Version 5 stores four compact profiles with brightness, shared Hall calibration, USB/scanner settings and shared gamepad tuning. Older journal versions can be read if intact. Full-image flashing clears the journal.
reporting: Known OEM interface0,endpoint1,8-byte boot keyboard reports,6KRO plus modifier bitmap. Not NKRO. Key bindings latch on press; duplicate usages deduplicated; all-zero release retries on USB busy. Configuration changes, calibration and reconnect force a release interlock. Linear percentage of learned range, not calibrated millimeters.

statusOffsets.9: running cadence shift (6 - active rate index)

ops.4: Fn2 usage: u8, offset physical key
ops.6: travel + coefficient: 2 x u16 LE, offset physical key
ops.7: gamepad mapping: u8, offset physical key
ops.8: device settings: rate, scanner mode, gamepad visibility, offset 0

profiles.rule: kind, key, second key, policy, four HID usages, three u16 LE depth or timing values. Rule kinds 0 off, 1 SOCD, 2 Rappy Snappy, 3 DKS, 4 Mod Tap, 5 Toggle, 6 Combination, 7 Macro, 8 Multi-Point Trigger, 9 End Key.
profiles.gamepad: 0 unassigned; 1-8 stick directions; 9-10 triggers; 11-20 Xbox buttons; 21-24 D-pad. Prefer D3 for controller changes.
profiles.layers: 0xFF is Fn1, 0xFD is Fn2, 0xFE transparent in either Fn layer. Keys latch their selected output until physical release.

operations.2: stage a configuration chunk, starting at offset 0
operations.3: apply complete configuration with four-byte little-endian CRC32, offset 0
operations.4: set USB visibility with a single 0 or 1 byte, offset 0. USB restarts after the reply.

configOffsets.2: 10 x 21-byte analog records: key, u16 start, u16 end, four u16 curve X points, four u16 curve Y points
configOffsets.212: 14 x 5-byte digital records: key, u16 press, u16 release
configOffsets.282: 2 x 5-byte stick records: u16 radial dead zone, circular flag, X and Y opposition policies

gamepad.positions: Physical key 0-35 or 255 for unassigned. Analog values and thresholds use 0-10000 of travel. Stick direction order is left, right, up, down for each stick, then LT and RT.
gamepad.usb: 19F5:FB4C. Enabled interface 2 uses FF/5D/01 with EP3 IN and OUT and XUSB10 compatible ID. USB device revision is 0x1501 when enabled and 0x1500 when disabled. Firmware version reply is 0x1500.
